allOf.description: Cross-field invariant, mirroring the DB CHECK licenses_inferred_rule: a status derived from an expiration date can NEVER be authority-confirmed.

description: Canonical shape of ONE normalized license record produced by a source adapter and accepted by the loader. Language-independent: this file (with the SQL DDL in db/migrations/) is the contract. TypeScript types are DERIVED from it, never the other way round. See docs/architecture/data-contract.md for versioning rules. EXAMPLE VALUES in this file's documentation are synthetic illustrations, not real licenses.

address.description: Business address as printed. NULL as a whole only when the source has no business-address columns (never in v1 — all three files have the columns; the FIELDS inside may be NULL).

city.description: City as printed (TDLR BUSINESS CITY, STATE ZIP — city part; TSBPE CITY). NULL by source design for HVAC (100% empty) and RMP rows without an address (48.9% empty).

county.description: County as printed (TDLR BUSINESS COUNTY; TSBPE COUNTY). The most complete geography: electrical 99.9%, HVAC 96.1% (BUSINESS COUNTY), RMP 99.8%. NULL only when the source cell is empty.

county_code.description: TDLR BUSINESS COUNTY CODE only (e.g. '0201'). Opaque source code — stored verbatim, never interpreted. NULL for TSBPE (no county-code column).

line1.description: TDLR BUSINESS ADDRESS-LINE1; TSBPE ADDR1. NULL by source design for HVAC (100% empty) and for RMP rows without an address (4,604/9,416 — exactly the rows with no phone/city either).

line2.description: TDLR BUSINESS ADDRESS-LINE2; TSBPE ADDR2. Mostly empty (RMP ADDR2 empty in 9,124/9,416 rows).

state.description: Two-letter state code ('TX' for Texas sources; RMP has a STATE column — 9113/9416 'TX', remainder OK/LA/NM/AR/...). NULL when the source gives no state (TDLR business city field embeds ', TX' — the adapter parses it; if unparseable, NULL, never guessed).

zip.description: ZIP as printed (TDLR BUSINESS ZIP / ZIP part of BUSINESS CITY, STATE ZIP; TSBPE ZIP). Stored as text — never as a number (leading zeros matter). NULL by source design for HVAC (100% empty).

business_name.description: Business name exactly as printed (TDLR BUSINESS NAME; TSBPE PLUMB_COMPANY). NULL when the source cell is empty (HVAC: 425/20,497 rows, 2.1%; RMP: 9/9,416 rows, 0.1% — in those rows the holder name is the only identity). Never invented by the adapter.

business_name_normalized.description: business_name lowercased, punctuation stripped, whitespace collapsed — the dedupe/search key. NULL exactly when business_name is NULL. The adapter MUST produce it deterministically (same input -> same output) so dedupe is reproducible.

contract_version.description: Contract version this record conforms to. Every normalized record MUST carry it. The loader rejects records whose contract_version it does not support.

endorsements.description: RMP endorsements: MEDGAS/MRF/WS where the source value is 'Yes'. Empty array [] for TDLR (no endorsement columns) and for RMP rows with all 'No'.

expiration_date.description: Source expiration date, ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). TDLR: LICENSE EXPIRATION DATE (' MM/DD/YYYY' with a leading space in the CSV — the adapter trims and converts). TSBPE: EXPIRATION_DTE ('MM/DD/YYYY'). NULL only if the source cell is empty (0% empty in all three 24/11/2026 files, but the schema allows it: a missing date forces verification_level='unverified').

holder.description: The person named on the license. NULL only if the source has no holder name at all (0% in all three 24/11/2026 files).

full_name.description: TDLR: NAME column as printed. TSBPE: composed as 'FIRST_NAME MIDDLE_NAME LAST_NAME SUFFIX' (omitting empty parts) from the four name columns.

insurance.description: RMP insurance fields only. NULL for TDLR (no insurance columns).

company.description: TSBPE INSURANCE_COMPANY. Empty in 11/9,416 RMP rows.

expiry_date.description: TSBPE INS_EXPIRY_DTE as ISO date. Empty in 11/9,416 RMP rows.

issue_date.description: License issue date, ISO 8601. TSBPE LICENSE_DATE only. NULL for TDLR (no issue-date column in the CSVs).

license_number.description: License number exactly as printed (whitespace-trimmed). Length varies by source (TDLR electrical: 5 chars; HVAC: 3-6; RMP: 1-5) — never assume a fixed length, never zero-pad.

license_status.description: The LICENSE's own status. TDLR (no status field): derived from expiration_date — 'active' if expiration_date >= file date, 'expired' if earlier, 'unknown' if expiration_date is NULL. TSBPE: mapped from LIC_STATUS ('Current' -> 'active', 'Expired' -> 'expired'). Any other source status value MUST be added to this enum by a contract change, never silently mapped to 'active'.

license_status_source.description: HOW license_status was derived. 'source_field' = the source file has a status column (TSBPE only in v1). 'expiration_date' = derived from the expiration date (all TDLR rows). 'gov_lookup' = confirmed by a direct .gov lookup. 'unknown' = no basis.

license_subtype.description: TDLR LICENSE SUBTYPE (e.g. 'EC' for electrical; 'AC' | 'AE' | 'BE' | 'BC' | 'AR' | 'BR' ... for HVAC). NULL for TSBPE RMP (no subtype column) and when the source cell is empty (1 HVAC row in the 24/11/2026 copy).

license_type.description: License type exactly as printed in the source (TDLR LICENSE TYPE: 'Electrical Contractor' | 'A/C Contractor'; TSBPE: 'Responsible Master Plumber'). Never translated or abbreviated by the adapter.

phone.description: Business phone exactly as printed (TDLR BUSINESS PHONE; TSBPE PHONE). NULL when the source cell is empty — BY SOURCE DESIGN, not by error: HVAC is 100% empty (the TDLR A/C file contains no business phone at all); RMP is 49.8% empty. The adapter MUST NOT substitute the mailing phone (TDLR PHONE NUMBER column is 99.9% empty for electrical and is the licensee's mailing phone, not the business phone).

phone_normalized.description: phone reduced to 10 US digits (strip formatting, drop a leading '1' country code). NULL when phone is NULL or unparseable. Used for dedupe matching and tel: links. Never store a partial/guessed number.

raw_row.description: OPTIONAL. The source row exactly as parsed (header names -> raw cell strings, untrimmed values preserved). Kept for audit/re-parse only; never displayed. Omit when size matters — the loader does not need it. If present, it MUST be the verbatim parsed row, not a re-serialized version.

source.description: Provenance of this record. Every record traces to an exact file (US1).

file_date.description: As-of date of the source file when the source states one; NULL when unknown (then status_as_of falls back to the run date — and MUST be recorded as the run date, not the file date).

sha256_checksum.description: SHA-256 of the downloaded source bytes (lowercase hex). Identical to ingestion_runs.sha256_checksum for the run that loaded this record.

source_url.description: Exact URL downloaded. NULL only if the download method has no URL (e.g. a manually supplied file) — in that case the run notes MUST say how the file was obtained.

source_code.description: Which government source file the row came from. Must match a row in data_sources.code. New sources are added by a MINOR contract version (new enum value) + a data_sources seed row.

status_as_of.description: Date the status statement is true as of — the source file's date (ingestion_runs.file_date when known, else the run date). Displayed to users as 'License status as reported in [source] on [status_as_of]'.

trade.description: Trade the license covers. Derived from the source, not from the business name.

verification_level.description: OUR confidence in license_status — independent of the status itself. 'authority-confirmed' ONLY when license_status_source is 'source_field' or 'gov_lookup'. 'inferred' when derived from expiration_date. 'unverified' when there is not enough data (e.g. expiration_date NULL, or conflicting sources). INVARIANT (also enforced by the DB CHECK licenses_inferred_rule): license_status_source='expiration_date' can NEVER pair with verification_level='authority-confirmed'.

notes.description: Optional operator note (added in v1.1, minor).
